summary: Silvercorp Metals Inc. filed a material change report on Form 6-K disclosing entry into a 3-year syndicated term loan facility agreement for RMB 1.5 billion (~$220 million) with a syndicate of international banks, led by Standard Chartered Bank. The facility is oversubscribed 2x from the original RMB 1 billion target. Proceeds are for general corporate purposes and global working capital. No special-situation event such as a merger, tender offer, or restructuring is involved; the filing is a routine financing update.
